title: Writing About Yourself
description: Learn to write about yourself and your life.

content.content:
## Writing About Yourself

When you meet new people, you often want to tell them about yourself. Let's learn how to do this in English!

content.title: Introducing Yourself
content.content:
**Basic information:**
- My name is _____.
- I am _____ years old.
- I live in _____.
- I am from _____.

**Example:**
"My name is Emma. I am 10 years old. I live in Oslo. I am from Norway."

content.title: Talking About Likes and Dislikes
content.content:
**Things you like:**
- I like _____. (I like football.)
- I love _____. (I love chocolate!)
- My favorite _____ is _____. (My favorite color is blue.)

**Things you don't like:**
- I don't like _____. (I don't like spiders.)
- I hate _____. (strong feeling!)

content.title: Talking About Hobbies
content.content:
**Hobbies = things you do for fun**

"In my free time, I like to _____."
"My hobbies are _____ and _____."

**Common hobbies:**
- playing football/video games
- reading books
- watching TV/movies
- drawing/painting
- swimming
- playing music

content.title: Example: A Short Text About Yourself
content.problem: Write a short introduction of yourself.
content.solution:
**Example text:**

"Hi! My name is Oliver. I am 10 years old and I live in Bergen, Norway.

I have one sister and one brother. My sister is older than me.

I like football and video games. My favorite subject at school is math. I don't like getting up early!

In my free time, I play football with my friends."

content.title: Making Your Text Interesting
content.content:
**Add details and examples:**
- Not just: "I like sports."
- Better: "I like sports, especially football. I play football every Saturday."

**Ask yourself:**
- Why do I like this?
- When do I do this?
- Who do I do this with?

exercise.task: Write three sentences about your hobbies. What do you like to do? When? With who?
exercise.solution: Example: "I like to play video games. I play every day after school. Sometimes I play with my brother."
hints: Use "I like to..." or "In my free time..."

exercise.task: Write a text about yourself (5-8 sentences). Include: your name and age, your family, your hobbies, what you like and don't like.
exercise.solution: Use the example text as a model. Remember to include all the required information!
hints: Start with basic info, then add more details

content.content:
## Oppsummering

I dette kapittelet har du lært:

- **Basic information**: You can say your name, age, where you live and where you are from.
- **Likes and dislikes**: Use 'I like', 'I love', 'I don't like' to talk about things.
- **Hobbies**: Hobbies are things you do for fun in your free time.

### Husk!
- Add details: not just 'I like sports', but why, when and with whom.
- Use 'I like' for things you enjoy and 'I don't like' for things you don't.
